game_title: Split Join Assembly – Glacier Crossing Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing, a cracking glacier: the sherpa guide must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Split Join Assembly: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing: a cracking glacier
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Crossing, repeat each round: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sherpa guide ahead. Then check the assembly value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the summit beacon by solving code steps involving assembly that move the sherpa guide forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the summit beacon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Split Join Assembly
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Split Join Assembly' (Week 8 slot 4), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Glacier Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how assembly changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
